Game modes
* I'm not sure whether Reverse mode is suitable for this clash, but let's see what others think.

Cases
* Please remove trailing newlines from the inputs and outputs of all cases.

* For Test/Validator 12, please include some instances where the threshold is reached exactly (in both directors, i.e. greater and smaller), as well as others where it falls short of the threshold by exactly 1 (again, in both directions).

Thanks.

Thanks. I removed trailing newlines from every test and validator input and expected output. Test/Validator 12 now each include at least two occurrences of all four boundary differences: +threshold, -threshold, +(threshold - 1), and -(threshold - 1), measured against the last transmitted value. I recalculated the outputs and all 24 cases pass in Python 3 and C locally, and in Python 3 in the CodinGame IDE.

Regarding Reverse, the public cases distinguish the last transmitted reference from the previous input or a fixed initial reference, and cover equality, decreases and a zero threshold. I have left it enabled for now and welcome other reviewers' views on its suitability.
